privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lede: Privacy Policy of ION Insurance Company, Inc.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Welcome to ION Insurance Company, Inc. (“ION”, “we”, “us”, or “our”). This Privacy Policy applies to your use of our website at https://ioninsuranceinc.com, including any content, functionality, and services offered on or through https://ioninsuranceinc.com.

items.text: This includes details submitted through contact forms, newsletter sign-ups, and any other interactions on our site where you input data voluntarily.
Automatically gathered data may include your IP address, browser type, browsing history, and other interactions with our site.

sections.title: Use of Information
list: Maintain, operate, and improve our website.
Analyze user behavior and trends to enhance user experience.
Communicate for marketing and promotional purposes.
Ensure the security of our website, prevent fraud, and enforce our legal agreements.

sections.title: Sharing of Information
paragraphs: We may share your data with:

items.text: Entities that perform services on our behalf, such as hosting, data analytics, and customer service.
When necessary to comply with laws or respond to lawful requests and legal processes.

sections.title: Data Protection
paragraphs: We implement security measures designed to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated occasionally, with the revised version reflected by the “Revised” date at the document’s top. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions or comments about this policy, please contact us below.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lede: Terms and Conditions for ION Insurance Company, Inc.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing https://ioninsuranceinc.com, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you disagree with any part of the terms, you must not use our website.

sections.title: Use of Website
paragraphs: The website is intended for personal, non-commercial use, except as explicitly permitted by these terms.

sections.title: Prohibited Activities
list: Using the site for illegal purposes.
Compromising the security of the site.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
paragraphs: All content, features, and functionality on the site are owned by, licensed to, or used with permission by ION Insurance Company, Inc., and are protected by copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.

sections.title: Amendments to Terms
paragraphs: We reserve the right to amend these Terms at any time. All changes are effective immediately upon posting to the website.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: For more details or to address any concerns, please contact us below.
